summary: `delivery_git.py publish-execution-plan`, `revise-unclaimed-scope` and `claim-items` now refuse a Delivery that the Integration records as cancelled with `DELIVERY_CANCELLATION_INVALID`. A cancellation writes the cancelled status on the Integration alone, and these verbs decided from the checkout's own `delivery.md`, so publishing the plan or revising the scope again put the Integration's `delivery.md` back to `execution_approved` or `scope_approved`, which left the cancellation Review unable to reach the target through its PR, and a Delivery cancelled before its claims could be claimed and started again. The message names finality and the PR route; the refusal comes before any ref moves. `begin-plan-revision`, `quiesce-upgrade` and `upgrade-target-merge` refuse such a Delivery the same way, since each wrote its record on top of the cancellation Review. `cancel-delivery` now refuses with `DELIVERY_BARRIER_ACTIVE` while the project Fence carries a plan revision barrier and names `finish-plan-revision` and `abort-plan-revision`: it carried the barrier, which outlived the cancellation's merge and refused every later reservation, and finishing the revision after it buried the cancellation Review.
